name: Private Libraries
description: Restricts which media each user sees. Titles appear when requested through Jellyseerr or added from a home-screen widget, using Jellyfin's per-user allowed-tags whitelist. This repository serves the Jellyfin 12.x (net10.0) build; Jellyfin 10.11.x servers should use manifest.json instead.
overview: Per-user media restriction via Jellyseerr requests and a home-screen widget (Jellyfin 12.x build).
